input.quote: Kubient hereby grants to Customer a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-assignable, without right of sublicense, revocable license to access, participate in and use to the full extent the Auction Platform as hosted by Kubient
input.rationale: The licence is expressly revocable at Kubient's discretion and excludes affiliates, contractors and any successor, which is walk-away territory under this rule (Section 6(a) also bars third-party access absent Kubient's written approval, so there is no path to add them). We deleted "revocable", extended the grant to affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf, and made it transferable to an M&A successor; termination of the licence remains governed by Section 4(c).
